conclusion: We introduced MolmoAct2 , a family of fully open action reasoning models built for real-world deployment across heterogeneous robot platforms. Building upon a spatially specialized Molmo2-ER backbone, MolmoAct2 produces performant and geometrically grounded behaviors across diverse manipulation tasks. We additionally release MolmoAct2 -Think, a thinking variant equipped with adaptive depth reasoning that delivers interpretable, depth-aware control with efficient inference. Our evaluations across simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that MolmoAct2 consistently outperforms strong VLA baselines out-of-the-box, fine-tunes efficiently from a handful of demonstrations, and transfers across three structurally different embodiments spanning the low-to-medium cost range.
